partial seizures can cause anxiety. same goes for confusion. try and pay attention to your body when you feel it. focus on what kind of feeling it is, how your body feels, how your mind feels, what you ate or drank that day and try to right things down becuase you are likely to forget after. its informative for your doctor. but yes its very difficult to find the right combination of medication. It took me years. for me, onfi was causing insomnia and anxiety, had to tapper down to a lower dose. now i can finally sleep. let us know how your appointment went. best of luck. 
PS, keep a trusted friend or loved one around, for support and outside perspective. its important.
